profile.name: Luis Bedoya Sandries
profile.headline: Bilingual Full-Stack & Cloud Developer
profile.bio: Student at Edmonds College finishing four associate degrees — AAS-T & ATA in Computer Information Systems and Web Application & Cloud Development (Dec 2026). I build full-stack tools that turn messy public data into something people can actually use.

projects.title: Washington Affordable Housing Search
projects.tagline: Statewide search engine for affordable housing
projects.description: A full-stack, special-purpose search engine that makes Washington's scattered affordable-housing landscape actually searchable. It crawls and indexes 2,800+ properties (Seattle Office of Housing, WSHFC/LIHTC, AppFolio portals) the way a web search engine does — respecting robots.txt, rate-limiting itself, touching only public pages — and maps live unit availability, pricing, and MFTE/MHA income qualification on an interactive map.

projects.title: Universal CS143 Notebook
projects.tagline: In-browser Java IDE — compiles client-side via WASM
projects.description: Browser-based Java IDE that compiles and runs Java entirely client-side (CheerpJ + WASM) and turns lab PDFs into interactive, Jupyter-style notebooks — with syntax highlighting, the Eclipse Java Compiler, and PDF export. No backend, no install: the whole toolchain runs in the tab.
projects.embedNote: This demo boots a full Java toolchain (CheerpJ + WASM) inside your browser. It loads on demand so browsing the portfolio stays fast.

projects.title: Java Data-Structure Visualizer
projects.tagline: Steps through Java while rendering trees, graphs & heaps
projects.description: Runs Java in-browser with CheerpJ, stepping through execution while rendering trees, graphs, heaps and hash tables in real time — built for CS143 Data Structures. Watch a BST rebalance or a hash table resize as each line of code executes.
projects.embedNote: Runs a Java VM (CheerpJ/WASM) in the tab — loaded on demand to keep navigation lightweight.

projects.title: CodeStepByStep Drawing Panel
projects.tagline: Canvas scratchpad for Java Graphics exercises
projects.description: Interactive drawing panel for CodeStepByStep Java Graphics exercises: versatile shape tools, smart object editing (move, resize, snap, clone), a scribble-to-erase gesture, full undo/redo state management, object locking, and one-click PNG export.

projects.title: MEXT English Review
projects.description: MEXT undergraduate English exam review — an interactive dashboard with section-by-section score breakdowns, grammar error analysis and a study roadmap, built with Astro and Tailwind.

projects.title: mac-scrcpy-env
projects.tagline: Android camera → macOS virtual webcam over ADB
projects.description: Streams an Android phone's camera feed to macOS as a virtual webcam over ADB and scrcpy — usable in Zoom, Teams, OBS, or any app. A reproducible shell environment driven by a Makefile: one command bootstraps dependencies, wires the device, and starts the stream.

projects.title: CIS 251 — SQL Final Project
projects.tagline: Relational database build-out & query portfolio in MySQL
projects.description: Final project for CIS 251 (Structured Query Language) at Edmonds College: built a complete multi-table HR database in MySQL Workbench from a 500+-record generation script, then demonstrated the full query lifecycle against it.
highlights: Created eight related tables (Names, Addresses, EmailAddresses, PersonalPhone, Job, JobCodeTable, PositionData, DepartmentTable) and wired referential integrity with ALTER TABLE foreign keys
Verified the data load with UNION'd COUNT(*) record-count reports across every table
Joined three-plus tables with aliased projections and WHERE filtering to answer business questions
Inserted new records across four related tables, then proved correctness with LEFT JOIN verification queries

projects.title: CIS 250 — Database Theory & Design
projects.tagline: Full design lifecycle: requirements → ERD → normalized schema
projects.description: Capstone for CIS 250 (Database Theory and Design): modeled a complete application database through two full design iterations — requirements gathering, entity-relationship diagramming, normalization, and a validated SQL schema.
highlights: Produced V1 and V2 full-scope design specifications, iterating on feedback
Normalized the model and expressed it as a validated schema-v2.sql
Practiced the same systems-analysis workflow used in CIS 233/234 coursework

projects.title: CS 143 — LinkedList Deque
projects.tagline: Double-ended queue on a doubly-linked list, in Java
projects.description: Project 2 for CS 143 (Computer Science III, Java): a double-ended queue implemented on a doubly-linked list — constant-time operations at both ends, iterator support, and edge-case handling for empty and single-node states. Flip to the Code tab to read the implementation.

projects.title: CS 143 — Midterm Practice
projects.description: Practice problems for the CS 143 Data Structures midterm at Edmonds College (Prof. Frank Shang) — working through stacks, queues, linked lists and recursion in Java. Flip to the Code tab to browse the solutions.

projects.title: BataBit — Responsive Crypto Landing
projects.description: A responsive cryptocurrency-exchange landing page hand-coded with HTML and CSS — mobile-first layout, fluid tables, and BEM-style structure, with zero frameworks.

projects.title: Wikipedia Clone
projects.tagline: Responsive rebuild of the multilingual portal
projects.description: Responsive clone of Wikipedia's multilingual portal built with pure HTML and CSS — precise typographic hierarchy and layout matching, no frameworks.

projects.title: Google Homepage Clone
projects.tagline: Pixel-faithful clone in pure HTML & CSS
projects.description: Pixel-faithful clone of the Google homepage built with pure HTML and CSS — an exercise in matching spacing, alignment, and interaction states exactly.

projects.title: GatitES Store
projects.tagline: Multi-page e-commerce site built with Sass
projects.description: GatitES — a multi-page cat-themed e-commerce site built with HTML, Sass and JavaScript: product grid, detail pages, and a consistent design system compiled from Sass partials.

projects.title: Practical JavaScript Calculators
projects.description: Interactive calculators for geometry, discounts and statistics built with vanilla JavaScript DOM manipulation — event-driven inputs, live results, and no dependencies.

projects.title: Avo Project
projects.tagline: API-driven rendering with vanilla DOM + Webpack
projects.description: DOM-manipulation exercise that fetches data from an API and renders product cards dynamically with vanilla JavaScript, bundled with Webpack.
